items.title: Transcription ke marhale aur mRNA ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the phases of transcription and mRNA processing (PDF 133-136).

blocks.text: Is marhale mein primer ki zaroorat nahin hoti. Enzyme RNA polymerase template DNA par nucleotides ke aik khaas sequence se jurta hai jise promoter kehte hain. Promoter khud transcribe nahin hota. Maslan:

items: Prokaryotes mein promoter TTGACA gene ke start point se 35 nucleotides pehle hota hai, is liye ise –35 sequence bhi kehte hain.
Prokaryotes mein doosra promoter TATAAT start point se 10 nucleotides pehle hota hai; ise –10 sequence kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Double-stranded DNA par prokaryotic promoter. Coding strand 5' se 3': -35 sequence par TTGACA, -10 sequence par TATAAT aur start point par A; template strand 3' se 5' par in ke complementary AACTGT, ATATTA aur T. Hara teer 5' se 3' transcription ki simt dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.13: Prokaryotes mein promoters (kitab ki Figure 19.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Coding strand, Template strand, -35 sequence, -10 sequence, Start point, Transcription, 5', 3'.

items: Eukaryotes mein promoter TATAAA (TATA box) start point se 25 nucleotides pehle hota hai; ise –25 sequence kehte hain.
Eukaryotes mein promoter GGCCAATCT (CAAT box) start point se 70 nucleotides pehle hota hai; ise –70 sequence kehte hain.

blocks.text: RNA polymerase paanch subunits (hisson) ka bana hota hai:

items: do α subunits regulatory proteins se jurte hain,
aik β′ subunit template DNA se jurta hai,
aik β subunit RNA nucleotides se jurta hai, aur
aik σ subunit promoter ko pehchaan kar RNA banna shuru karta hai.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Prokaryotes mein sirf aik RNA polymerase hota hai jo teenon qisam ke RNA banata hai. Eukaryotes mein teen alag RNA polymerases hain: RNA polymerase I nucleolus mein rRNA banata hai, RNA polymerase II mRNA banata hai, aur RNA polymerase III tRNA banata hai.

Jab RNA polymerase promoter se jurta hai to us ka σ subunit alag ho jata hai. Baqi chaar subunits (core enzyme) kaam aage barhate hain: DNA helix kholte hain aur nucleotide pairs (base pairs) torte hain. Is se bulbule jaisa structure banta hai jise transcription bubble kehte hain. RNA ki zanjeer isi bubble mein banti hai.

Transcription bubble ke andar RNA polymerase template DNA strand ke saamne complementary ribonucleotides ki zanjeer banana shuru karta hai. Yeh 5′ se 3′ ki simt mein hota hai aur aam taur par A ya G ribonucleotide se shuru hota hai. Yahan jurne wale nucleotides ribonucleoside triphosphates (rNTP) ki shakal mein hote hain. Jab rNTP jurta hai to us ke do phosphate energy chhorte hue alag ho jate hain aur ribonucleotide zanjeer se jur jata hai.

Naye mRNA ke pehle 12 bases template DNA ke saath aik aarzi (temporary) helix banate hain. Is se mRNA ka 3′ sira apni jagah tikka rehta hai aur agla ribonucleotide le sakta hai. Har nucleotide jurne par RNA-DNA helix ghoomta hai, is liye RNA ka 3′ sira RNA polymerase ki catalytic site (kaam wali jagah) par hi rehta hai. Transcription bubble DNA par aage barhta hai, barhta hua mRNA bubble se bahar nikalta hai, aur bubble guzarne ke baad transcribe hua DNA dobara lipat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Gulabi RNA polymerase ke andar transcription bubble. Aage DNA khul raha (unwinding) aur peeche dobara lipat raha (rewinding) hai. Coding strand (peela) oopar se guzarta hai; template strand (neela) ke saath naya mRNA (narangi) chhota DNA-RNA hybrid helix banata hai, us ka 3' sira barhta aur 5' sira bahar nikalta hai. rNTPs andar aate hain; hara teer harkat ki simt.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.14: Transcription ka elongation marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Template strand, Coding strand, Rewinding, Unwinding, mRNA, DNA-RNA hybrid helix, rNTPs, RNA polymerase, 5', 3'.

blocks.text: Template DNA par gene ke aakhir mein aik stop codon hota hai. Is ke baad stop region hota hai: pehle GC nucleotide pairs (base pairs) ka silsila, phir AT pairs ka silsila. Jab yeh hissa mRNA mein transcribe hota hai to mRNA strand ke andar hi hydrogen bonds ban jate hain. mRNA ke apne andar ki yeh base-pairing aik loop banati hai jise GC hairpin kehte hain, aur us ke baad chaar ya zyada U ribonucleotides ki dum (tail) hoti hai. GC hairpin RNA polymerase ko rok deta hai (pause). mRNA ke chaar U aur DNA ke A ka jor sab se kamzor hota hai, is liye is lambe waqfe mein yeh RNA-DNA hybrid ko thaam nahin sakta. Natija yeh ke RNA strand transcription bubble ke andar DNA strand se alag ho jata hai aur transcription ruk jati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: RNA polymerase DNA ke stop region par ruka hua, mRNA ka UUUU sira stop region se jura, aur peeche mRNA mein GC hairpin. Alag khaane mein hairpin ka silsila: 5' C A, phir C G G C G C jo G C C G C G se jure hain, loop G G C U U aur 3' dum U U U U U. Neeche: polymerase azad, DNA strands dobara lipat gaye aur mRNA alag ho gaya.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.15: Transcription ka termination marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Polymerase paused, Stop region, GC hairpin, Polymerase released, DNA strands rewind, mRNA separates.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Stop region ke G-C hisse se bana mRNA khud par muR kar GC hairpin banata hai. Is se polymerase ruk jata hai, aur peeche kamzor A-U jore (UUUU) aasani se toot jate hain, is liye mRNA alag ho jata aur polymerase azad ho jata hai.

Prokaryotes mein nucleus nahin hota aur transcription cytoplasm mein hoti hai, is liye un ke naye mRNA ko translation shuru karne ke liye kahin jana nahin parta. Eukaryotic cells mein naye mRNA ko nucleus se cytoplasm tak safar karna hota hai. Is safar ke liye naye mRNA mein yeh tabdeeliyan ki jati hain:

1- 5′ cap lagana: mRNA ka pehla nucleotide (5′ sire par) A ya G hota hai. Is A ya G ke 5′ sire par aik methylated GTP jor diya jata hai; yeh bond A ya G ke 5′ sire aur GTP ke 5′ sire ke darmiyan banta hai. Is structure ko 5′ cap kehte hain. Yeh safar ke dauran mRNA ko nucleases aur phosphatases (RNA torne wale enzymes) se bachata hai.

2- 3′ poly-A tail lagana: mRNA ke 3′ sire par taqreeban 250 A nucleotides ki chhoti zanjeer jor di jati hai jise 3′ poly-A tail kehte hain. Yeh mRNA ko nucleases se tootne (degradation) se bachati hai.

blocks.alt: Template DNA 3' se 5': promoter aur chaar exons jin ke beech teen introns. Transcription se immature mRNA (5' se 3'); 5' cap (GTP) aur 3' poly-A dum (AAAA) ka izafa; mRNA splicing introns nikal kar mature mRNA deti hai: 5' cap, protein-coding sequence, 3' poly-A dum, cytoplasm jane ke liye tayyar. Qaus (bracket) transcription ke baad ke qadmon ko post-transcriptional modifications dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.16: Eukaryotes mein transcription ke baad tabdeeliyan (kitab ki Figure 19.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Template DNA, Promoter, Exon, Intron, Transcription, Immature mRNA, Addition of 5' cap and 3' Poly-A tail, GTP, 5' Cap, 3' Poly-A Tail, mRNA splicing, Mature mRNA, Protein-coding sequence, Ready to move to cytoplasm, Post-transcriptional modifications.

blocks.text: 3- Splicing: naya mRNA kaccha (immature) hota hai kyun ke us mein introns (DNA ya mRNA ke woh hisse jo protein ka code nahin dete) aur exons (woh hisse jo "express" ho kar protein mein translate hote hain) dono hote hain. mRNA splicing woh amal hai jis mein immature mRNA se introns nikal diye jate hain aur baqi exons aapas mein jor diye jate hain. Is tarah pukhta (mature) mRNA mein sirf coding hisse (gene) rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Eukaryotic mRNA ko 5′ cap aur poly-A tail ki zaroorat kyun hai, prokaryotic mRNA ko kyun nahin?
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotic mRNA ko nucleus se cytoplasm tak jana hota hai; cap aur tail raaste mein use nucleases jaise enzymes se bachate hain. Prokaryotic mRNA cytoplasm hi mein banta hai aur foran translate ho jata hai.

items: Initiation: RNA polymerase (σ subunit) promoter se jurta hai; primer nahin chahiye.
Elongation: transcription bubble mein rNTPs se RNA 5′ se 3′ banta hai.
Termination: GC hairpin + U wali tail se RNA alag ho jata hai.
Eukaryotes: 5′ cap, 3′ poly-A tail aur introns ki splicing.
